bias.en: Rebound · slipped under the 5-day, holding the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 跌破 5 日均线，守住 10 日均线

read.en: Intel fell 2.5% on Nov 13 to $59.66, trading $57.00–61.34 on light volume (0.69x the 20-day average). It is above the 10-day ($58.82) and below the rising 5-day ($60.17), the 30-day ($83.87), 100-day ($98.16) and rising 200-day ($87.40). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($74.91), and RSI is 32.4.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月13日下跌 2.5%，收于 $59.66，盘中区间 $57.00–61.34，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.69 倍）。股价位于 10 日均线（$58.82）上方，位于上行的 5 日均线（$60.17）以及 30 日（$83.87）、100 日（$98.16）和上行的 200 日均线（$87.40）下方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$74.91），RSI 为 32.4。

read.en: The close slipped under the 5-day and $60, now resistance, but the dip to $57.00 recovered above the 10-day. Resistance is $60.2–61.3 (5-day, Nov 12–13), then $62.5–62.8 and $64.1. Support is $58.1–58.8 (10-day, Nov 4 and 10 closes), then $56.8–57 (Nov 4–13 lows) and $54.6. A close above $61.3 would target $62.5–62.8; below $58.1, $57.
